description: This file defines the TimesheetService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It manages timesheet operations such as retrieving detailed timesheets, creating timesheets based on dates, handling timesheet items, and managing workflow states related to timesheets. It interacts with data access objects, state machine services, and entity classes to perform its functions.

classes.name: TimesheetService
classes.description: Service class managing timesheet operations, including creation, retrieval, item management, and workflow handling within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the AccessFlowStateMachineService instance.

methods.name: getTimesheetDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the TimesheetDao instance.

methods.name: getTimesheetPeriodService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the TimesheetPeriodService instance.

methods.name: getDetailedTimesheet
methods.description: Fetches a detailed representation of a timesheet by its ID, including rows and columns data.

methods.name: getTimesheetData
methods.description: Constructs and returns the data structure representing timesheet rows and columns for a given timesheet entity.

methods.name: createTimesheetByDate
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet for a specified date, setting the appropriate workflow state and date boundaries.

methods.name: extractStartDateAndEndDateFromDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the timesheet period containing the given date based on configuration.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForDate
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for a specific employee on the week containing the given date.

methods.name: createTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Converts an array of row data into TimesheetItem entities linked to a specific timesheet.

methods.name: generateTimesheetItemKey
methods.description: Generates a unique string key for a timesheet item based on its identifiers and date.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates or updates timesheet items from provided row data and saves them.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowsForTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves permissible workflow state transitions for a given timesheet based on user roles and current state.
